address: 10-13 Fengle Road, Beitun District, Taichung, Taiwan
bio: It may look like a hipster café from the outside, but the warm, relaxing interior boasts some 10 counter seats around an open kitchen. The Taichungese-born, Singapore-trained chef fashions a tasting menu in omakase style that blends Taiwanese traditions with subtle influences from various Chinese regions. The modern, creative score is shrewd and restrained, while still feeling familiar and comforting.
